title: Battle of Formentera
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Formentera", at revision 1370440840, opens: "The Battle of Formentara occurred on 28 October 1529 when an Ottoman fleet under Aydin Reis captured a small Spanish fleet of eight galleys off the island of Formentera near Ibiza." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4871030, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1529 Ottoman-Spanish naval battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
